game_data: path to the game's LUNACID_Data folder
unity: leave out to use Unity Hub's default install of 6000.0.85f1
android_sdk: leave out to use the SDK of Unity's Android module
android_ndk: leave out to use Unity's NDK
jdk: leave out to use Unity's OpenJDK
dotnet: leave out to use dotnet on the PATH or in <work>/tools/dotnet
